title: LLMSeg: Training-Free Text-Prompted Image Segmentation with B-Splines
abstract: arXiv:2610.29409v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Promptable segmentation models such as SAM 3 achieve remarkable open-vocabulary performance but require dedicated architectures, large-scale annotation engines, and task-specific training. We ask a different question: can a general-purpose multimodal large language model (MLLM) segment images directly, without an added segmentation head, mask decoder, or training? We present LLMSeg, a training-free pipeline that turns a vision-capable LLM into a text-prompted image segmenter. LLMSeg decomposes segmentation into three LLM-driven stages. First, detect localizes all instances matching a free-form text query and describes their coarse morphology. Next, segment traces each instance using closed periodic B-splines confined to its detected box. These splines define an outer boundary and optional hole loops. translated_title: LLMSeg：基于B样条的无训练文本提示图像分割
translated_abstract: 可提示分割模型（如SAM 3）在开放词汇分割上取得了卓越的性能，但需要专门的架构、大规模标注引擎以及针对任务的训练。我们提出了一个不同的问题：通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能否直接分割图像，而无需添加分割头、掩码解码器或进行任何训练？我们提出了LLMSeg，这是一个无需训练的流水线，能将具备视觉能力的LLM转变为文本提示的图像分割器。LLMSeg将分割任务分解为三个由LLM驱动的阶段。首先，detect（检测）阶段定位所有匹配自由文本查询的实例并描述其粗略形态。其次，segment（分割）阶段使用局限于检测框内的闭合周期B样条来描绘每个实例。这些样条定义了外边界以及可选的孔洞环。最后，refine（细化）阶段迭代地在残留误差周围提出聚焦框，并在受限范围内重新描绘样条。当掩码稳定后，该过程结束。
tldr: LLMSeg提出了一种无需训练的图像分割方法，将分割任务分解为检测、B样条轮廓追踪和迭代细化三个由大语言模型驱动的阶段，使多模态大语言模型无需分割头或掩码解码器即可直接完成文本提示的图像分割。
en_tdlr: LLMSeg is a training-free pipeline that turns a vision-capable LLM into a text-prompted image segmenter by decomposing segmentation into LLM-driven detection, closed B-spline boundary tracing, and iterative refinement stages, without requiring any segmentation head, mask decoder, or task-specific training.
